purpose: Show that the Python workflow detects documented data problems instead of silently accepting or deleting them.
boundary: This report uses a disposable copy of the 20-record reference dataset with four deliberate errors: an ID mismatch, an incorrect metadata length, an invalid amino-acid character and an exact duplicate sequence. It tests data-quality checks only. It is not a toxin classifier and does not evaluate biological prediction performance.
